objections.claim: At candidate sha256:d686bc0466bccba9c113a9b83b77cf35b5d927f4ffa04e1c3e65d2bdbc079cfc, the branch publisher's mandatory startup proof is inoperable. E1 requires the publisher to verify its credential as non-bypass using full ruleset and classic-protection enumeration before any push, but §5(e) limits that GitHub App to contents:write + pull_requests:write with no administration/ruleset permission. GitHub requires Administration:read for branch-protection retrieval, and omits bypass_actors unless the caller has write access to the ruleset ([protected-branch API](https://docs.github.com/en/enterprise-cloud@latest/rest/branches/branch-protection), [rulesets API](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/orgs/rules)). The candidate's signed configuration attestation does not repair this: it is one-time, merge-dossier-bound, and issued in the later Eye-local merge ceremony after the publisher has already pushed. Therefore a compliant publisher must fail for incomplete visibility, or skip the promised proof and permit a misconfigured bypass-capable publisher credential. Specify a publisher-specific, pre-publication privileged attestation/freshness mechanism or another operable server-enforced design, with regressions for the real 403/omitted-bypass responses.
